name: Grafana Agent Observability
description: Grafana Cloud's agent observability built on OpenTelemetry gen_ai spans.
descriptionZh: Grafana Cloud 基于 OpenTelemetry gen_ai span 的 Agent 可观测能力。
keyFact: Grafana Cloud offers Agent Observability for evaluating and improving production AI agents, consuming OpenTelemetry gen_ai.* spans so it fits an existing Tempo/Prometheus stack; the exact product name is 'Agent Observability', not 'Grafana AI Observability'.
keyFactZh: Grafana Cloud 提供 Agent Observability，用于评测与改进生产环境的 AI Agent，它消费 OpenTelemetry 的 gen_ai.* span，可融入现有的 Tempo/Prometheus 技术栈；其官方产品名是 Agent Observability，而非 “Grafana AI Observability”。
